changes.basis: R5 source evidence calls these coarse NDHM/GIS envelope solids, not wall, facade, floor-plan, or exact roof-edge geometry. They obscure the independently modeled facade and are retained unchanged as hidden reference geometry.
Officially attributed exterior photo of the building shows the large cantilever canopy underside in a dark red-brown metallic finish; previous base color was gray-blue.
changes.patch_sampling_note: The dark visible canopy region was sampled approximately from the source photo; surrounding sky/glazing pixels are excluded from the material inference. A red-brown metal approximation is used; exact paint/ACM manufacturer color is unverified.
